diff --git a/agentplane/runner/journal/journal.go b/agentplane/runner/journal/journal.go
index d7ab0ed2e5..2f228fd53e 100644
--- a/agentplane/runner/journal/journal.go
+++ b/agentplane/runner/journal/journal.go
@@ -91,9 +91,6 @@ func Open(ctx context.Context, path, sourceID string) (*Journal, error) {
 	db.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
 	db.SetMaxIdleConns(1)
 	for _, pragma := range []string{
-		// DELETE-mode commits need an exclusive lock. Online backup readers may
-		// briefly hold shared locks; wait before treating contention as a storage failure.
-		"PRAGMA busy_timeout=5000",
 		"PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE",
 		"PRAGMA synchronous=EXTRA",
 		"PRAGMA foreign_keys=ON",
@@ -464,7 +461,10 @@ func (j *Journal) CommitBatch(ctx context.Context) error {
 		return nil
 	}
 	if _, err := j.conn.ExecContext(ctx, "COMMIT"); err != nil {
-		return j.failBatchLocked(batch, err)
+		batch.active = false
+		j.failure = err
+		j.notifyLocked()
+		return &StorageError{Err: err}
 	}
 	j.publishLocked(batch.appended, batch.sealChanged, batch.sealOverride)
 	batch.active = false
@@ -556,7 +556,9 @@ func (j *Journal) write(ctx context.Context, operation func(*journalBatch) error
 		return err
 	}
 	if _, err := j.conn.ExecContext(ctx, "COMMIT"); err != nil {
-		return j.failBatchLocked(batch, err)
+		j.failure = err
+		j.notifyLocked()
+		return &StorageError{Err: err}
 	}
 	j.publishLocked(batch.appended, batch.sealChanged, batch.sealOverride)
 	return nil
